description: Header file defining the MediaCodecList class, which manages media codec information and provides methods for codec lookup and matching within the Android media framework.

classes.name: MediaCodecList
classes.description: Manages a list of media codecs, provides lookup and matching functions, and interfaces with Android's media framework.

classes.name: BinderDeathObserver
classes.description: Handles death notifications for binder objects to manage media codec list lifecycle.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of MediaCodecList.

methods.name: findCodecByType
methods.description: Finds a codec matching the specified MIME type and encoder flag, starting from a given index.

methods.name: findCodecByName
methods.description: Finds a codec by its name.

methods.name: countCodecs
methods.description: Returns the total number of codecs available.

methods.name: getCodecInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a codec at a specific index.

methods.name: getLocalInstance
methods.description: Returns a local instance of the media codec list for MediaPlayerService.

methods.name: profilerThreadWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper function for profiler thread, used internally.

methods.name: findMatchingCodecs
methods.description: Finds codecs matching specified MIME type, encoder flag, optional format, and flags.

methods.name: isSoftwareCodec
methods.description: Checks if a given component name corresponds to a software codec.

methods.name: codecHandlesFormat
methods.description: Determines if a codec can handle a specific format.
